# Faraj Software Solutions

> Faraj Software Solutions builds practical business software for small and medium-sized businesses that need clearer scheduling, cost control, pricing, and operating decisions.

## Primary product

### Shift Planner

Shift Planner is the main available product from Faraj Software Solutions. It is a web-based staff scheduling and labor cost planning tool for small and medium-sized businesses.

Shift Planner helps owners and managers:

- Build weekly employee schedules.
- Add employees with roles, wages, maximum hours, and unavailable days.
- Enter projected revenue by day or by week.
- Estimate labor cost before a schedule is finalized.
- Compare labor cost against projected revenue.
- Track labor percentage of revenue.
- Set staffing coverage targets by day.
- Review overstaffing, understaffing, and labor-heavy days.
- Build suggested schedules using business settings such as labor targets, minimum staff, busy days, availability, and max-hour limits.
- Save schedules for later.
- Export schedules to CSV.
- Print a clean schedule view.
- Undo the last schedule action while editing.

Shift Planner is designed for small and medium-sized businesses including restaurants, retail shops, auto shops, salons, spas, rental businesses, service businesses, and other local operators that manage hourly staff.

Primary page: https://www.farajsolutions.com/schedule-builder.html
Client portal: https://login.farajsoftwaresolutions.com

## Positioning

Faraj Software Solutions is not built only for restaurants. The company serves small and medium-sized businesses that need practical software for daily operations, cost control, and decision support.

The strongest current search focus should be:

## Other site sections

### Custom Software

Faraj Software Solutions also offers custom business software for SMB workflows. The company can build practical tools around business-specific operations such as scheduling, pricing, cost tracking, customer workflows, admin dashboards, and internal decision tools.

Page: https://www.farajsolutions.com/custom-software.html

### Market Signals

Market Signals is a business-focused economic indicators dashboard that helps small and medium-sized businesses understand cost pressure from inflation, supplier costs, fuel, interest rates, labor pressure, and broader economic conditions.

Page: https://www.farajsolutions.com/market-signals.html

### Pricing Assistant

Pricing Assistant is a future cost-control product focused on item pricing, margins, labor, overhead, waste, and pricing scenarios. Shift Planner is the current primary available product and should receive the strongest SEO emphasis.

Page: https://www.farajsolutions.com/pricing-assistant.html
Demo page: https://www.farajsolutions.com/pricing-assistant-demo.html
